label: Routing violations to the right fixer
section: Routing violations to the right fixer
subgoals: Separate violations on routed metal from those inside cells
Map each violation class to its owning engine
Sum the violations routed to each engine

label: Classifying violations
subgoals: Group markers by rule, layer and cell context
Look for one cause behind many markers
Assign each group to a fix, an escalation or a deck check

label: Closing the loop safely
subgoals: Accept a fix only when full DRC and LVS pass with no new markers
Rerun extraction and timing after routing changes
Stop the loop when progress stalls and escalate
